title: Amazon - you should be ashamed of yourselves.
text: Living in NorCal (basically, the Land of Amazon Prime) our community house goes through serious amounts of coffee - so we were intrigued to see a subscription service offered by Amazon. Having read the fine print - this is absolutely f*$%ing insane. A 12-ounce bag of coffee, once monthly, for $26? Outrageous! The (swanky, organic, locally roasted, totally hipster) shop on our corner pioneered the 12-ounce bag (which is already annoying) and they only charge $14.99 for it. WHY WOULD ANYONE EVER DO THIS? On all levels (carbon footprint, financial spend, etc) this is the most wasteful thing we've seen. C'mon Amazon - you can do better.
label: negative
